title: Build Your Own Neural Network From Scratch
summary: These notes are based on our reading of Michael Nielsen's online book neuralnetworksanddeeplearning.com. They represent our effort to elaborate his exposition of neural networks and to provide supporting mathematical detail. Our goal is to provide self-contained instructions for building a basic neural network in the form of pseudocode, so that an interested reader can build a network from scratch and know why it works.
